verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an API-first product. Its documented public product data API has a versioned reference (/api-reference/v1/search), free API keys, and no OAuth requirement, and an official SDK and CLI are built on the same API. A developer reports building a product on top of it. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at standard paths, and there is limited independent hands-on corroboration of the API's breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Access 100 million+ products from 25,000+ brands through one API.
No OAuth flow is required for the public product data API. API keys are free to create.
Optional user identifier to attribute clicks and sales to a user in your system. Channel3 appends it to buy URLs in the response.
The Channel3 CLI calls the Channel3 API from a terminal or script.
Install the Channel3 SDK, authenticate, and make async calls.
